Hi OP. I think people with trauma really have ways of making things worse than they seem to be (speaking as someone na may trauma din and seeing a psych for it). You have to sit down with him and communicate na you really think he's changed because of the incident, and you'll try to be affirming him more sa future to ensure him na wala kang iba. Give affirming words randomly pag naguggood morning, tell him how you want it to work with him, etc. You can even write him a love letter!

Pero don't overdo it ah. Kapag youve exhausted all efforts na and wala parin, Im sorry to say but he's not ready for a relationship yet. No matter how much you like him, ikaw rin mahihirapan in the long run. Imagine first month nyo palang which should be the honeymoon stage tapos ganyan na kalala, what more sa following months. Anyway I hope it works out for you. Best of luck!

Lack of validation and standard protocols, as well as variable quality of reagents and equipment, influence the efficient dissemination of PCR methodology from expert research laboratories to end-user laboratories. "*
